div.b: Why ABAC and not RBAC alone?

ul.li: roles say who; zero trust also needs where (zone, layer), when (time, emergency) and how much (trust score)
the trust score turns a static policy into a continuous one without rewriting rules
least privilege per zone: a PMU may write only its own zone's telemetry (sameAs)
short TTLs on dangerous actions (breaker 10 s, break-glass 1 s) force frequent re-decisions

div.div: Why deny-overrides? It is the only combining algorithm where adding a rule can never open access that a deny closes. Combined with default deny, a typo in a rule makes the system stricter, never more open.

text.tspan: Why deny-overrides? It is the only combining algorithm where adding a rule can never open access that a deny closes.
Combined with default deny, a typo in a rule makes the system stricter, never more open.
